Title: Live point-by-point scoring
Description: Tap to award points to either team in real time. The interface is optimised for one-handed use during active play.

Title: Set management
Description: Automatic set tracking with configurable winning conditions. TournaQ handles the transition between sets without manual input.

Title: Serving player tracking
Description: The active server is highlighted within the team card. Service changes when the non-serving team scores. The serving player indicator updates automatically on every point.

Title: Score correction
Description: Undo the last point at any time. Mistakes during fast play can be corrected immediately without losing match state.

Title: Time Control
Description: React to timeouts or other time affecting events by restarting , pausing, adding or removing time from the timer

Title: Match result & history
Description: Completed matches are saved locally on the device with full score history per set.

Title: Landscape scorecard
Description: Rotate the device at any point to switch to landscape mode. All controls remain accessible in the rearranged layout — designed for net-post placement or table-side scoring.

Title: Hard Session Timing
Description: enforce time management

Title: Target Points Setting
Description: Set individual Target Points, system will remind you that you have reached the target score

Title: Side Change Automation
Description: When the combined score reaches the side-change point, TournaQ shows the Side Change dialog and swaps the counters automatically. Switch the automation off to swap sides manually with gesture control.

Title: Automatic Referee/Admin Suggestion
Description: Get automatic and fair referee suggestions from the tournament player pool for all games in your tournament.

Title: Manual Gameplays
Description: Some formats require dynamic administration because players are constantly rotating. With Manual Gameplay the admin selects the new team or players manually after each selection

Title: Automated Gameplays
Description: Some formats require dynamic administration because players are constantly rotating. With Automated Gameplay player or teams are queued fairly and the admin only needs to take care of scoring and ejecting.

Title: Auto-Allplay Gameplay
Description: Some formats require dynamic administration because players are constantly rotating. With Auto-Allplay Gameplay TournaQ automatically assignes and rotates game admins, so no one has to sit out.

Title: Tournament creation & setup
Description: Define the event name, date, venue, number of courts, and participant list before play begins.

Title: Match scheduling
Description: Assign matches to courts and time slots. Handle court changes and late adjustments without manual recalculation.

Title: Pace alerts
Description: Every scorecard tracks the scheduled time slot for its match, so players keep an overview of where they stand against the clock and stay on schedule.

Title: Injury & withdrawal handling
Description: Mark teams as withdrawn mid-tournament and automatically adjust brackets and standings without corrupting results already recorded.

Title: Singleplayer Competitions
Description: Individual Player scramble and randomization. Compete for points per player

Title: Share Scorecards and Results via QR Code
Description: Generate QR Codes to share Scorecards and Results even when offline.

Title: Multi-court parallel tracking
Description: Run multiple simultaneous matches across courts within a single event, with results feeding into shared standings.

Title: Team Competitions
Description: Compete focus on Partner Play and Team Standings

Title: Inline Tournament Editing
Description: Adjust Tournament parameters during the ongoing event.

Title: Multi-device sync
Description: Keep match data in sync across multiple devices at the same event — so scorekeepers and organisers always see the same state.

Title: Live court score display
Description: A consolidated view showing current scores across all active courts — updated in real time as scorekeepers enter points.

Title: Real-time standings
Description: Group standings and bracket positions update automatically as match results come in, without manual entry or refresh.

Title: Spectator view
Description: A read-only view of live scores, standings, and match schedules accessible to spectators — no account or app required.

Title: Public tournament URL
Description: Each event gets a shareable URL that spectators, players, and coaches can open on any device to follow the tournament live.

Title: Live bracket visualisation
Description: An interactive bracket diagram that updates live as matches complete — shareable with teams and displayable on venue screens.

Title: Mobile-first design
Description: Optimised for use on smartphones. Touch targets, layout, and navigation are designed for one-handed use during a live match.

Title: Offline-first local storage
Description: All match data is stored on-device using local storage. TournaQ works fully without an internet connection — no signal required on court.

Title: Portrait & landscape orientation
Description: The scoring interface adapts to both portrait and landscape orientations to suit different holding preferences and device types.

Title: Large screen tournament view
Description: A dedicated layout for larger screens that shows multiple courts or full bracket views simultaneously — designed for tournament control rooms.

Title: Cast to display
Description: Project the live scoreboard or bracket view to an external screen or TV at the venue — for spectators and team benches.

Title: Three top-level destinations
Description: The Home screen splits the app into TournaQ Arena for all games and tournaments, Administration for players, teams, and groups, and More for everything alongside them. Everything else branches off these three.

Title: More
Description: More collects the screens that sit beside the main flow: Contact & About (social links, support channels, legal documents, and the app version), Sponsoring & Promo (advertising and partnership opportunities), and Settings.

Title: Straightforward navigation
Description: Every route follows the same shape — from a top-level destination into a hub, from the hub down to the next level of detail, and back the same way. No hidden paths and no dead ends.

Title: TournaQ Arena mode hub
Description: Every game and tournament mode is grouped into three categories — Quick Games, Single Competitions & Socials, and Team Competitions — each a large tappable card.

Title: Mode availability at a glance
Description: Available modes are shown in gold with a badge counting the tournaments already played in that mode. Modes still in development appear in grey with a "Soon" badge.

Title: Built-in mode help
Description: An info icon on every mode card explains the format before you commit to it, with a "Learn more" link through to the website.

Title: Three-step path to a scorecard
Description: Pick a mode, configure the setup, open a match. The path is identical in every format — learn it once and it applies to all of them.

Title: Tournament dashboard
Description: Each tournament opens on a dashboard showing the full schedule grouped by round, with team names, courts, times, match status, and a completion percentage. Tap any match to score it.

Title: Tournament history by mode
Description: Past tournaments are saved on the device and listed in the Arena's history panel, grouped by mode with a total count — so any previous event is a couple of taps away.

Title: Coming Soon feature cards
Description: Modes and features still in development appear as cards in the Arena and on the Home screen, each linking through to the website, the feedback form, and email.

Title: Language & privacy settings
Description: Settings offers four language options — Automatic, English, Deutsch, Español — and a Privacy Options link for managing ad consent choices.

Title: Reusable player & team library
Description: Players, teams, and groups are saved once and available in every mode — Quick Games, Social Scrambles, King of the Court, Doghouse, and Single Elimination. No re-entering names each session.

Title: Players hub with search & filters
Description: Every saved player in one searchable list, filterable by name, team, or tournament. Each entry shows how many teams, groups, and tournaments the player belongs to, and can be edited or deleted inline.

Title: Create players
Description: Add a player with a name — or a suggested one — and optionally assign them to existing teams and groups at the moment of creation.

Title: Export & import players, groups & teams
Description: Export your player, group, and team data and import it back — or onto another device — so setting up a bigger event doesn't mean re-entering every name by hand.

Title: Teams hub with saved rosters
Description: Pre-formed teams are stored with their player rosters and can be browsed by name, player, or tournament. Each entry shows the player count and group membership.

Title: Create teams
Description: Name a team, link it to existing player profiles, and assign it to one or more groups. It is immediately available in the Add Existing Teams list across all bracket modes.

Title: Groups for clubs, venues & series
Description: Organise players and teams into groups that represent a club, a venue, or a recurring event series. A player or team can belong to several groups at once.

Title: Group filtering during setup
Description: Every player and team import panel offers a group filter, so a club session can be set up by filtering to that group and adding its members in a few taps.

Title: Add existing players in-game
Description: During tournament setup, Add Existing Players opens the full saved library with search and group filter. Tap + on any name to add them, with a counter tracking the remaining spots.

Title: Add existing teams in-game
Description: In bracket modes, Add Existing Teams lists all saved teams with their player counts. Adding a team loads its player names automatically, ready to appear on scorecards.

Title: Inline player import in Quick Games
Description: Each player slot in a Quick Game team has a search icon that opens the Players Hub inline — find a saved player and drop them straight into the slot without leaving the screen.

Title: Edit players in ongoing tournaments
Description: inline editing (quick game) or via tournament player management

Title: Stored on the device, no account needed
Description: The whole administration library lives locally on the device and works without an internet connection or a sign-up.

Title: Add Random Players or Team
Description: Too Lazy to set up actual Players or teams? Let the system create random Players and Teams for you.
